preconditions.description: The input must be an integer.
The input integer must be non-negative.

postconditions.description: If there are no consecutive odd digits, the output is the same as the input number.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '0123456789-' for c in stdout)
postconditions.description: The output string must contain only digits and dashes.

postconditions.expression: all(stdout[i] == '-' and stdout[i-1] in '13579' and stdout[i+1] in '13579' for i in range(1, len(stdout)) if stdout[i] == '-')
postconditions.description: Dashes must be inserted only between consecutive odd digits.
